description: This file defines the `GatewayProcessManager` class responsible for managing the lifecycle of a gateway process within an application, including starting, stopping, attaching to existing instances, and monitoring its status. It handles environment checks, launchd integration, logging, and connection health checks.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the lifecycle and health of a gateway process, including starting, stopping, attaching, and environment checks. It also manages logging and connection health, and integrates with launchd for auto-start.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: An enum representing the current status of the gateway process, such as stopped, starting, running, attached to an existing instance, or failed.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the gateway process, handling remote mode and controlling start/stop accordingly.

methods.name: ensureLaunchAgentEnabledIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically enables the launch agent for the gateway if not already enabled, respecting configuration and environment.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Attempts to start the gateway process if it is desired and not already running, preferring to attach to existing instances before spawning.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the gateway process and cleans up associated state.

methods.name: clearLastFailure
methods.description: Resets the last failure reason to nil.

methods.name: refreshEnvironmentStatus
methods.description: Checks and updates the environment status, rate-limiting refreshes.

methods.name: refreshLog
methods.description: Refreshes the in-memory log from the gateway log file.

methods.name: attachExistingGatewayIfAvailable
methods.description: Tries to connect to an already-running gateway on the configured port to avoid spawning a new process.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Generates a textual description of a gateway instance or health snapshot.

methods.name: describeAttachFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable reason for failure to attach to an existing gateway.

methods.name: isGatewayAuthFailure
methods.description: Determines whether an error indicates a gateway authentication failure.

methods.name: enableLaunchdGateway
methods.description: Enables and waits for the launchd-managed gateway process to startup.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends a string to the in-memory log, trimming if necessary.

methods.name: refreshControlChannelIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes the control channel if it is disconnected or degraded.

methods.name: waitForGatewayReady
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for the gateway to become ready within a timeout.

methods.name: clearLog
methods.description: Clears the in-memory log and deletes the log file.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Sets the project root path via CommandResolver.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the current project root path.

methods.name: readGatewayLog
methods.description: Reads the gateway log file up to a specified character limit.
